# noust_project (Resource)

A project of a team. Creating one also creates its `production` environment. Deleting a project is refused by the server while it still holds anything, and always for a team's `default` project.

Needs the permission `teams.manage` and sudo mode to delete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "noust_project" "web" {
  team = noust_team.acme.slug
  name = "Web"
  slug = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The project's display name.
- `team` (String) The slug of the team the project belongs to. Changing it replaces the project.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) The project's slug. Made from the name when omitted. Changing it replaces the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The team's slug and the project's, joined with a slash: `team/project`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The team's slug and the project's, joined with a slash.
terraform import noust_project.web acme/web
```
